answer: Proof-of-Dwell identity weighting: each agent's influence grows only through continuous, verifiable task participation, tracked as a decaying attention ledger. An identity that goes hollow loses weight within hours, so attackers cannot cheaply park idle accounts as spare relics for later use. To sustain many identities at once, an attacker must divert real compute and attention across a nebula of parallel sessions, paying the full opportunity cost of foregone productive work per identity, continuously.
